description: This is a frontend HTML file that constitutes the user interface for a database visualizer component. It contains the structure and styles for browsing databases, tables, and viewing data, along with embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and updates the sidebar list.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing a database to view its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying tabular data with optional expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling object structures and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or object data.
